aiPrompts.title: AI Invoice Intelligence Analysis
aiPrompts.description: Use ChatGPT to intelligently analyze invoices, extract data, detect anomalies, and validate against purchase orders.
aiPrompts.prompt:
Let's use AI to analyze your 9TC invoices! 🤖

**What I'll do:**
1. Scan all invoices in ~/9TC-Project-Data/Invoices/
2. Use ChatGPT vision to extract:
   - Supplier name and ABN
   - Invoice number and date
   - Invoice amount and GST
   - Line items and quantities
   - Payment terms and due date
   - Special conditions or notes

3. AI Validation:
   ✓ Check supplier name against records
   ✓ Validate GST calculation (1/11 of amount)
   ✓ Compare against purchase orders
   ✓ Flag unusual prices or quantities
   ✓ Detect duplicate invoices
   ✓ Highlight payment term changes

4. Smart Actions:
   ✓ Auto-categorize by supplier/trade
   ✓ Flag invoices for human review
   ✓ Route high-value invoices (>$50k) for approval
   ✓ Add all clean invoices to sheet
   ✓ Generate exception report

**Benefits:**
- Catch invoice errors before payment
- Reduce manual data entry by 95%
- Identify supplier fraud patterns
- Maintain audit trail

Shall I analyze all your invoices with AI now?
aiPrompts.author: 9TC AI Team
